description: A4988 stepper demo: STEP = PA0 TIM2 pulses with a trapezoidal ramp in the update IRQ, DIR PB0, MS1-3 PB12-14, EN PB15; +1600 (1/8), -100 (full), -800 (1/8) steps, USART1 log
expect:
72 MHz; TIM2 PSC 71 (1 us counts), PWM mode 1 on PA0 (AF push-pull), CCR1 = 10: every timer period starts with a 10 us STEP pulse; ARR is rewritten in the update interrupt for the next period (trapezoid: linear frequency ramp over `ramp` steps, cruise, symmetric ramp down) and the last period has CCR1 = 0, so exactly N pulses leave. PB0 (DIR), PB12-14 (MS1-3), PB15 (EN, low) push-pull. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1: 'A4988 stepper demo
', then after 300 ms: 'move +1600 steps 1/8 (1 rev)
' (DIR=1, MS=110, 400 -> 3200 steps/s), 'done, position 1600/8 full steps
'; 300 ms; 'move -100 steps full (1/2 rev)
' (DIR=0, MS=000, 200 -> 400 steps/s), 'done, position 800/8 full steps
'; 300 ms; 'move -800 steps 1/8 (1/2 rev)
', 'done, position 0/8 full steps
'; repeat. A NEMA 17 on the A4988 (VMOT 12 V, VDD 3.3 V, RST-SLP tied) turns +1, -1/2, -1/2 revolution.

circuit: PA0 (STEP), PB0 (DIR), PB12-PB14 (MS1-3), PB15 (EN): A4988 carrier in the full circuit (motor position covered by tests/devices/motors-firmware.test.ts); unconnected on this bench
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
